description: Dear Friend, It's an honor to come back for our weekly recap of week 3 of the 445th legislative session in Maryland; we only have 72 days left, and I couldn't be prouder of the work we've already accomplished in such a short time. Monday- The Environment and Transportation committee released their early 2023 session briefing schedule.
